description: Cyclotourisme - Canal de Berry is a dataset listed in COEUR DE FRANCE open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Canal de Berry à Vélo. Véloroute "Coeur de France à vélo". Coverage: Cœur de France (Cher). The portal files it under Attractivité. Its keywords are vélo, cyclotourisme, tourisme, Mobilité. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-coeurdefrance-fr-portal.
